headline: Abbott Laboratories (ABT) Could Be 10% Undervalued On Its $1.35b Buyback Update
summary: Abbott Laboratories buyback update Abbott Laboratories (ABT) has completed a share repurchase tranche that saw the company buy back 14,015,097 shares for about US$1.35b, including 11,599,094 shares between April and June 2026. See our latest analysis for Abbott Laboratories. Abbott Laboratories shares trade at US$107.81 and have gained 27.86% over the past 90 days, while the year-to-date share price return is down 13.19% and the 1-year total shareholder return is down 17.86%.
